AUSNOX | Jezero crater, Mars
Real NASA/USGS observations. A hypothetical Marswalk.

Compare shortest traversable and lower-slope routes.
Outbound and return legs are calculated independently.

The 3D view uses the same verified elevation grid.
Display height scale does not change route measurements.

Review both route legs, walking time and science stops.
The return margin accounts for the selected reserve.

Move the simulated start to 14:00 Mars local solar time.
The original science activities still fit the window.

Increase the destination activity from 30 to 240 minutes.
The mission becomes infeasible: the return margin is insufficient.

Every source distinguishes observations, calculations and assumptions.
X2b image registration remains unresolved; small hazards are not resolved.

NASA observations change a Marswalk decision.
Educational simulation. Not operational navigation or NASA-endorsed safety advice.
